description.fun: Darumaka is a living Daruma doll, and its Fire type comes from the ceremony where old Daruma dolls are burned. While the fire inside it burns, it can't sit still and runs around, but as the flame dwindles it tucks in its limbs and falls asleep, and then, like a tumbler doll, it can't be knocked over. Its droppings are so warm that people once tucked them into their clothes to keep warm.
description.guide: Darumaka is a Fire-type Pokémon based on a Daruma doll, very active while the fire inside it burns and asleep once the flame shrinks. It evolves into Darmanitan. In Galar it has an Ice-type regional form, Galarian Darumaka.
description.tagline: A roly-poly Daruma doll with a fire in its belly.

description.fun: Long ago Galar's climate cooled and Darumaka's inner fire went out, leaving an organ that makes cold air instead. The colder it gets, the livelier it becomes, freezing its breath into snowballs for playful snowball fights, and it loves the icy berries Snover grow.

Darmanitan's punches can obliterate a dump truck, powered by an inner fire that burns at 1,400 °C. When badly hurt, it hardens into a stone-like statue and meditates, sharpening its mind to fight on, and one in this Zen Mode was found asleep in the Relic Castle after 2,500 years. Its designer saw Daruma dolls burned at a ceremony that happened to look like gorillas, hence its look.
description.guide: Darmanitan is the evolved form of Darumaka, a powerful Fire-type Pokémon whose strength rises with the temperature of its inner fire. When weakened it can enter Zen Mode, becoming a Fire- and Psychic-type statue. In Galar it has an Ice-type regional form with its own Zen Mode.
description.tagline: A hot-blooded gorilla Daruma that turns to stone to meditate.

description.fun: When badly hurt, it turns blue, pulls in its limbs and becomes as hard as stone, a still Daruma doll that meditates to sharpen its mind and spirit. Its blank eyes, shut mouth and covered ears may recall the three wise monkeys.

Galar's cold made it a gentle, timid yeti with a giant snowball on its head, where it stashes food to take home for later. It's so shy it pretends to be a snowman when people are near, but it freezes its snowball solid before a powerful headbutt.

Anger reignites Galarian Darmanitan's dormant flame sac, turning it into a rampaging snowman with a fiery 'carrot' nose. It hops about spewing fire everywhere and won't stop until its rage settles, even if its own body starts to melt. No other Pokémon shares its Ice and Fire typing.
